brand.name: KAYO MESTIZA
brand.description: Where 90s streetwear drop culture collides with high-octane Filipino-American street eats. Charcoal-grilled skewers, smash griddle bangers, crisp lumpia, and sweet bakes fueled by Filipino heritage.

surfaces.name: hero
surfaces.guarantee: scrim: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(11, 12, 16, 0.88) 0%, rgba(11, 12, 16, 0.7) 45%, rgba(11, 12, 16, 0.96) 100%), radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.18) 0%, transparent 70%)

rules: Hero display heading: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none with multi-color graffiti drop-shadow
Section headlines (H2): text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-tight
Body text: text-base (sm:text-sm on mobile compact items), leading-relaxed, max tracking 0.02em
Overlines / Chapter stamps: Geist Mono uppercase text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-[0.25em] text-[#FFD700]

entry_surfaces./: split kinetic hero — bold masked graffiti reveal + badge cluster left, interactive 3D spotlight food showcase & quick-action cards right

visual_enhancers.stickers_and_badges: Angled sticker tags (-3deg to 4deg rotate) with 2px solid crisp borders, drop shadow [3px_3px_0px_#000], bold uppercase copy
visual_enhancers.clipped_frames: Food photography encased in industrial clipped-corner frames (polygon clip-path or heavy 2px inset borders with yellow corner brackets)
visual_enhancers.sun_motif: Filipino 8-ray golden sun motif (custom SVG icon) used as divider, watermark, and chapter accent
visual_enhancers.flame_accents: Subtle animated glowing flame particles on griddle showcase and hero backdrop
visual_enhancers.halftone_and_grain: CSS SVG grain texture overlay with mix-blend-mode: overlay for authentic 90s streetwear zine feel

motion.engine: motion (framer-motion) with Lenis smooth momentum scrolling

hero_intro.masked_reveal: staggerChildren: 0.12s, clipPath: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0% 100%) transition: { duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }

marquee.speed: 28s infinite linear scroll with pause-on-hover, bold typography separator
marquee.content: BLASIAN FIRE ★ FRESH LUMPIA ON DECK ★ TOCINO SMASH BURGERS ★ BABOY SKEWERS SIZZLING ★ STREETWEAR DROPS ★ BOOK CATERING NOW

cards_interaction.hover: translate-y-[-4px] scale-[1.01] shadow-[0_12px_24px_rgba(255,69,0,0.2)] border-amber-400 transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease

accessibility.contrast_standard: All text and interactive glyphs meet minimum WCAG AA 4.5:1 against respective surfaces
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap animations with prefers-reduced-motion queries or disable heavy transforms when requested
accessibility.screen_readers: All decorative stickers and SVGs have aria-hidden='true', interactive modals and cart drawers follow base-ui aria guidelines

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Mount fonts in frontend/src/index.css: Use @fontsource-variable/space-grotesk for headers and @fontsource-variable/dm-sans for body text.
2. Maintain strict mobile-first responsiveness. The sticky order bar at the bottom must be prominent on mobile devices and tablet screens.
3. Implement an interactive cart/order drawer with simulated state (add items from menu, adjust quantity, choose pickup location, and simulate checkout with Sonner toast feedback).

4. Ensure all interactive buttons, tabs, inputs, and links include distinct data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-view-menu-btn', data-testid='menu-tab-lumpia', data-testid='catering-submit-btn').
5. Use framer-motion (motion/react) for smooth stagger reveals, sticker hover pops, and Lenis for silky smooth scrolling.
6. Do not use generic white or light backgrounds for main cards; use rich deep charcoal #141721 with high-contrast sticker badges (#FFD700, #CE1126, #0038A8, #FF4500).
7. Include all required menu items with authentic descriptions, prices, spice indicators, and dietary badges.
